verdict.rationale: Asana is a project-management product, so a multi-project portfolio rollup is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents a portfolio view or any native cross-project progress rollup. The closest items do not count toward this story: an API tutorial for building your own status-update report is a developer building block, MCP-driven 'reports and summaries' is an adjacent feature, and exporting data to a BI tool via Fivetran is a user-side workaround.
